About the role

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.
  • Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.
  • Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.
  • Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.
  • Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.
  • Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.
  • Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.
  • Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.
  • Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.
  • Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of:

  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.
  • HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.
  • JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.
  • Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.
  • Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.
  • txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.
  • Structured data and Schema.org.
  • Core Web Vitals and web performance.
  • International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.
  • Website and platform migrations.
  • Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

  • Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.
  • Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.
  • Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.
  • Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.
  • Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.
  • Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.
  • Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.
  • Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.
  • Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.
  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.
  • A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.
  • An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.
  • Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 
 
Our compensation: 

  • A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.
  • Hybrid working flexibility.
  • Access to learning platforms .
  • Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 
  • Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 
  • Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 
  • At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

  • A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise.

  • Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations.

  • Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice.

Must-have Experience & Skills:

  • 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business.

  • Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model

  • Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security.

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it.

  • Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication.

  • Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own.

  • Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions.

  • Humble.

Nice to Have:

  • An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution).

  • Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities.

  • Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks).

  • Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent)

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. raw.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
description: Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou! Wat ga je doen? Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. Jouw belangrijkste taken: Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten. Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen. Wat krijg je van ons? Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT: Een jaarcontract ( 32 - 36 uur per week ) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur per week); Extra’s : Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%); Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan; Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn; Ontwikkelmogelijkheden : Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen; Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto. Wie ben jij? Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert. Verder heb je: Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als leidinggevende; Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in zorgmanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting én een aanvullende cursus of opleiding gevolgd op het gebied van verander- en/of crisismanagement; Ervaring met begeleiding van meerdere verander- of crisismanagement trajecten in de zorg; Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht. Waar ga je werken? Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt. Enthousiast? Zie jij jezelf helemaal terug in bovenstaand profiel en hebben we jou geënthousiasmeerd met onze mooie unieke functie? Solliciteer dan direct online! Controleer altijd na het indienen van je sollicitatie of je een bevestiging in je (spam)mailbox ontvangen hebt. Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Bel gerust even met onze recruiter: Marloes Alteveer via 06-4843 0289 of Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments. At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable. In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation. You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions. What you'll do: Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release. Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints. Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications. Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support. Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation. Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met. Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities. Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity. Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance. Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis. Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities. Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations. Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week. Qualifications: MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with a focus on mechanical design of opto-electronic, electronic, photonic, or other high-tech hardware products. 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments. Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products. Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release. Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments. Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar. Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation. Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification. Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style. Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance. Nice to have: Experience with fiber-optic integration, optical component packaging, or photonic hardware development. Experience with CE/FCC, MIL, NATO, and/or STANAG qualification standards. Experience with ruggedized chassis standards used in defense, marine, aerospace, or industrial applications (e.g. VPX, CompactPCI, uTCA). Experience managing external suppliers, manufacturers, and development partners. Experience supporting environmental qualification, certification, or product compliance programs. Please note that we can only consider candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands and already have the legal right to work here without requiring visa sponsorship or a work permit. title: Senior Project Manager (Subsea)
description: We are looking for a Senior Project Manager (Subsea) to lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, with a strong focus on offshore, subsea or marine-related operations. In this role, you will manage complex technical projects involving internal teams, external partners and customers. You will be responsible for keeping projects on track, managing expectations, identifying risks early and ensuring successful delivery within scope, time and budget. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren. Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie. Je; analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen; adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes; ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen; ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen; bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen; werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability; werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers; helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau; draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic. De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning. Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten. Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere; Python Airflow Apache Spark Kafka Docker Tensorflow Pytorch Kubernetes Terraform AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom. Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen. Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Daarnaast is het van toegevoegde waarde als je ervaring hebt met: consultancy binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen; solution architecture of technical leadership; Kubernetes en Terraform; Spark, Kafka en/of Airflow; TensorFlow en/of PyTorch; generative AI en Large Language Models (LLM's); deep learning, causal inference of reinforcement learning; Scala, Kotlin en/of SQL; open-sourceprojecten, meetups, conferenties of andere vormen van kennisdeling. We verwachten niet dat je met iedere technologie uit onze stack hebt gewerkt. De senioriteit van je ervaring, het daadwerkelijk in productie brengen van machine-learningoplossingen, je vermogen om klanten inhoudelijk te adviseren en je beheersing van het Nederlands zijn voor deze rol wel essentieel. Je bent technisch sterk, maar kijkt verder dan alleen de technologie. Je kunt complexe situaties doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en uitleggen waarom een bepaalde oplossing wel of niet verstandig is. Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met engineers, architecten en business stakeholders. Tegelijkertijd blijf je graag zelf bouwen. BigData Republic zoekt geen consultant die alleen vanaf de zijlijn adviseert: je combineert senior technisch advies met hands-on Machine Learning Engineering. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: About the role Data science is in a moment of reinvention: AI-generated code and agentic workflows are changing what it means to put analytical work into production. Posit’s mission is to empower people to conduct trustworthy data analysis for themselves, their organizations, and the world at large. Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands. We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands. About you You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most: High agency You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers. Boldness in learning You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential. User empathy and product sense You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity. Collaborative curiosity You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck. Interest in AI You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it. Results-driven You are focused on delivering measurable value to customers. You have a strong technical background with a track record of shipping successful products. Within one week, you will… Ship code changes that meaningfully improves the experience for our customers. Within one month, you will… See your changes reflected in our public releases. Participate in feature planning and provide feedback. Feel comfortable navigating the codebase and understand how things fit together. Within three months, you will… Plan features and drive their development. Have a track record of teaching team members; both from your expertise and things you learn as you build. Have a track record of learning: both from the things you learned and taught us along the way; and from listening to internal users, external users, and how our customers use our products. Within six months, you will… Point to new features you built that we hadn’t even dreamed were possible. Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States. Hiring Range $141,800—$187,110 USD Working at Posit: We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms . We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously. We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit. We operate under a unique sustainable business model : We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now. Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here . Notable: We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only. 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans. Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members. Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents. All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one. After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions. An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year. We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office. We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home. Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support. We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays. Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you! Posit is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of different backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. Posit Software, PBC participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire. E-Verify Participation Notice (English/Spanish) Right to Work Notice (English/Spanish) #LI-REMOTE

Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey. Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn . **Travel to Office expectations** For Remote Roles : If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings. For Hybrid Roles : If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role. About the team: This team provides solutions that streamline internal processes, improve implementations and deliver scalable, autonomous services across our employee facing corporate platforms. We work closely with senior leadership, solution architects, and product teams to bring LLM-driven agents and intelligent workflows into production across a dynamic healthcare SaaS environment. Job Summary: This role exists to bring AI-powered automation into real-world use across our corporate platform. This role exists to bring AI-powered automation into real-world use across our corporate platform. It focuses on building intelligent workflows with leading enterprise AI platforms (primarily Microsoft Azure, alongside model providers such as Anthropic Claude and OpenAI) to streamline operations and enhance delivery. The position connects IT and operations with AI innovation to deliver measurable impact in a rapidly evolving environment. Key Responsibilities: •Build and support AI agents and intelligent workflows using Microsoft Azure tools such as Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, and Copilot Studio. •Design and implement AI-powered orchestration and automation for use cases such as configuration streamlining, onboarding automation, and data migration. •Collaborate with cross-functional teams (integration, implementation, product, support) to deliver high-quality, scalable AI-driven solutions. •Develop APIs, scripts, and tools to connect LLM-based agents — using open integration standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — with existing enterprise systems. •Support testing, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI workflows in production, including output-quality evaluation, guardrails, and responsible-AI safeguards. •Stay current with the AI platform roadmaps of major providers (Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) and emerging industry trends. •Contribute to the evolution of our internal AI delivery model and promote AI best practices across teams. Your Key Strengths: •Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. •Experience building AI-powered workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio and/or Now Assist. •3–5 years of experience in software or cloud engineering •Exposure to AI agent orchestration or multi-agent systems •Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure AI, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Cognitive Services) •Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or vector database integration. •Experience working with multiple LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Azure OpenAI, Gemini), prompt engineering, and AI-driven automation. •Proficient in Python, C#, or JavaScript/ T ype Script •3-5 years' experience working in SaaS or enterprise environments. •Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and cloud deployment practices. •Understanding of healthcare data formats (HL7, FHIR) is a strong plus. •Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn in a fast-moving environment. With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

**Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

About the team:

This team provides solutions that streamline internal processes, improve implementations and deliver scalable, autonomous services across our employee facing corporate platforms. We work closely with senior leadership, solution architects, and product teams to bring LLM-driven agents and intelligent workflows into production across a dynamic healthcare SaaS environment.

Job Summary:

This role exists to bring AI-powered automation into real-world use across our corporate platform. This role exists to bring AI-powered automation into real-world use across our corporate platform. It focuses on building intelligent workflows with leading enterprise AI platforms (primarily Microsoft Azure, alongside model providers such as Anthropic Claude and OpenAI) to streamline operations and enhance delivery. The position connects IT and operations with AI innovation to deliver measurable impact in a rapidly evolving environment.

Key Responsibilities:

•Build and support AI agents and intelligent workflows using Microsoft Azure tools such as Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, and Copilot Studio.

•Design and implement AI-powered orchestration and automation for use cases such as configuration streamlining, onboarding automation, and data migration.

•Collaborate with cross-functional teams (integration, implementation, product, support) to deliver high-quality, scalable AI-driven solutions.

•Develop APIs, scripts, and tools to connect LLM-based agents — using open integration standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — with existing enterprise systems.

•Support testing, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI workflows in production, including output-quality evaluation, guardrails, and responsible-AI safeguards.

•Stay current with the AI platform roadmaps of major providers (Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) and emerging industry trends.

•Contribute to the evolution of our internal AI delivery model and promote AI best practices across teams.

Your Key Strengths:

•Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

•Experience building AI-powered workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio and/or Now Assist.

•3–5 years of experience in software or cloud engineering

•Exposure to AI agent orchestration or multi-agent systems

•Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure AI, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Cognitive Services)

•Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or vector database integration.

•Experience working with multiple LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Azure OpenAI, Gemini), prompt engineering, and AI-driven automation.

•Proficient in Python, C#, or JavaScript/Type Script

•3-5 years' experience working in SaaS or enterprise environments.

•Familiar with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and cloud deployment practices.

•Understanding of healthcare data formats (HL7, FHIR) is a strong plus.

•Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn in a fast-moving environment.

title: Engineering Manager - Observability | UK | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are considering candidates in Germany, Sweden, Spain, Ireland and the UK only. The opportunity: Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack. The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it. What is the Ingest team? We build and maintain the configuration and deployment tooling that bridges the gap between "I want observability" and "I have observability,". To achieve this the team owns Fleet Management , the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart , and the Instrumentation Hub . Fleet Management is the cloud-based central control plane our customers use to manage hundreds of thousands of Observability Collectors in the wild. The Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart is used to effectively deploy Observability Collection in Kubernetes based environments. The Instrumentation Hub seamlessly combines Fleet Management and the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart to achieve a magic 1-command instrumentation experience. What You'll Be Doing: Manage and develop the team of backend and frontend engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting each person’s growth through career conversations. This is a remote team, distributed between EMEA and NASA. Collaborate closely with go-to-market to ensure customers and prospects are successful with their Observability collection journey. Work closely with product and engineering leadership to ensure Fleet Management, the Kubernetes Helm Chart, and the Instrumentation Hub fit seamlessly into the end-to-end user experience for Grafana cloud products. Provide guidance throughout the project lifecycle from early ideation through planning, execution and post‑launch guiding the team to deliver high‑quality results consistently. Foster a psychologically safe environment where engineers can learn, experiment and iterate quickly, encouraging innovation and a culture of continuous improvement. Work across team boundaries by contributing to projects outside your team’s scope and partnering with other functions to solve customer problems. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What Makes You a Great Fit: Experience in either of these areas is a strong advantage: Observability (especially OpenTelemetry), or building a central control plane that manages fleets of collectors. You will be comfortable working with engineering teams who have a strong sense of autonomy in their decision-making, be it technical or product focused. While you’re great with people and adept at managing relationships, you still keep up-to-date with the latest technical trends and shifts in order to maintain and enhance your understanding of the challenges your teams face. Comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, empathetic communication to build trust, connection, and psychological safety. Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, align stakeholders, and elevate team performance to deliver meaningful, high-quality results. Deeply customer-focused, consistently grounding decisions and technical choices in user needs and real-world impact. Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, including scalability, fault tolerance, consistency, and observability. Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools and ideally have practical experience folding them into a team’s workflow. Compensation & Rewards: In the UK, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,000 - GBP 129,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

title: Software Developer, Mobile Platform
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We're growing fast and hiring the Engineering talent to match. You'd be joining our Mobile team within the Platform Engineering division. We treat our internal developer platform as a real product, with internal customers (our feature teams, 150+ developers) and adoption metrics.The mission for this role: make it dramatically faster and safer to ship mobile features at MaintainX. Today, feature teams reinvent patterns, fight with build infrastructure, and ship slower than they should because the foundations underneath them are inconsistent. We want a mobile foundation where feature teams stop thinking about CI, release trains, shared components, and observability, they just build features. What you’ll do: Design, build, and maintain mobile React Native foundations and tooling powering our internal developer platform. Bring AI native workflows into your daily work and into the platform. Raise engineering excellence standards. Lead to the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: SDKs, CI pipelines, build tools, local development golden paths. Collaborate with other platform teams and product development teams on defining and adopting the internal developer platform. About you: 4+ years of mobile engineering experience Expert in React Native Proficient building shared modules, SDKs, and reusable components for cross-team use. Strong understanding of Mobile DevOps Strong AI mindset An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis. Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com . For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging . More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Solutions Architect (EST or PST hours)
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. raw.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

  • Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

  • Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

  • Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

  • Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

  • Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation

  • 50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

  • 20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

  • 15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

  • 10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

  • 5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days

  • First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

  • 60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

  • 90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you...

  • Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

  • Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

  • Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

  • Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

  • Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

  • See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have

  • 3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

  • Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

  • Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

  • Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had

  • Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with API-first products and developer tools

  • Background in change-management or implementation methodology

  • Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Identifies, documents, and prioritizes bugs in JIRA or similar tools. Re-tests fixed defects and performs regression testing before releases. Collaborate with the development team to test more complex features and identify potential edge cases. FIRST 90 DAYS: HITTING YOUR STRIDE Gained increased knowledge of the System under test Increased ownership of testing tasks or projects Provide feedback to the team on onboarding processes and identify areas for improvement in QA workflows.
